## Professional facts

- Current role: Senior Fullstack Developer at Bosch Global Software Technologies.
- Location: Bengaluru, India.
- Experience: More than five years building scalable web applications and leading engineering teams.
- Core frontend technologies: Angular, React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Core backend technologies: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, REST APIs, GraphQL, Python, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
- Additional focus: Generative AI integrations, workflow automation, accessibility, UI/UX, CI/CD, and mentoring.
